notes:
CLAUDE.md at the repo root is the conventions file: house rules, boundaries, and the warning that a green suite is not evidence here. docs/design/DESIGN.md (v0.4) is the SPEC, not a conventions file - the plan phase reads it; build iterations read their task slice.

Test layout: Go colocates tests with source, so source_dirs and test_dirs are identical. test_single_command uses $(dirname) and must run through a shell (bash -c), not exec'd directly.

Lint: golangci-lint is NOT installed. Plain `gofmt -l .` exits 0 even on unformatted files - hence the `test -z "$(...)"` wrapper.

Runtime: system curl is the execution engine, hard floor curl >= 7.70 for --write-out '%{json}'. Installed: curl 8.14.1. No database, no services, no .env needed.

State as of 2026-08-03: all 33 plan tasks complete and merged to main. A review loop then found 32 findings (8 CRIT) and escalated - see REVIEW_FINDINGS.md and REVIEW_ESCALATION.md. `go test ./...` is green WITH those findings live, so it is not a gate for remediation work. Phase 2a is specified in docs/plans/2026-08-02-phase-2-boundary-design.md.
